description_en: Queries the cross-region log backup files of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询跨地域日志备份文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-cross-region-log-backup-files --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cross-backup-region cn-shanghai --start-time 2019-05-30T12:10:00Z --end-time 2019-06-15T12:10:00Z --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCrossRegionLogBackupFiles

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination region within which the cross-region backup file is stored. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackupDBInstance operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份目的地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeCrossRegionBackupDBInstance查看地域ID
parameters.name: cross_backup_region

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Valid values: any non-zero positive integer.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

CrossBackupRegion.description_en: The ID of the destination region within which the cross-region backup file is stored

CrossDownloadLink.description_en: The external URL from which you can download the cross-region log backup file
CrossDownloadLink.description_zh: 跨地域日志备份外网下载链接

CrossIntranetDownloadLink.description_en: The internal URL from which you can download the cross-region log backup file
CrossIntranetDownloadLink.description_zh: 跨地域日志备份内网下载链接

CrossLogBackupId.description_en: The ID of the cross-region log backup file

CrossLogBackupSize.description_en: The size of the cross-region log backup file. Unit: bytes
CrossLogBackupSize.description_zh: 跨地域日志备份文件大小，单位：Byte

LinkExpiredTime.description_en: The time when the URL expires. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LinkExpiredTime.description_zh: 下载链接过期时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

LogBeginTime.description_en: The start time of the cross-region log backup file. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LogBeginTime.description_zh: 跨地域日志备份文件记录的开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

LogEndTime.description_en: The end time of the cross-region log backup file. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
LogEndTime.description_zh: 跨地域日志备份文件记录的结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

LogFileName.description_en: The name of the cross-region log backup file
LogFileName.description_zh: 跨地域日志备份文件名称

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
页码，取值：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。

默认值：1

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of cross-region backup files on the current page

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries that are returned
